scope: Known permitted owner cache control; correctness/authentication/state/accounting only, no fresh HE/private HE/timing/CUDA or originality approval

control.owner: Honest owner may retain all plaintext and provision a current descriptor, symmetric key and signature anchor through a trusted channel
control.backup: Uncompressed compact binary vectors and UInt64 ordered IDs, standard cryptography AES-256-GCM-SIV with fresh 12-byte nonces and context-bound AAD
control.authentication: Ed25519 owner signature over a domain-separated kind/context/ciphertext-hash descriptor; verify signature/current context/packet digest before AEAD, authenticate before parsing, publish only after complete validation
control.context: Opaque namespace/key/snapshot IDs, UInt64 monotonic epoch, bounded count/dimension and complete ordered-ID digest; no public plaintext-row hash
control.freshness: Current context is a separately trusted owner pin; server-signed or replayed descriptors do not advance it. Late acquisition and stale patches reject. Host-resistant rollback/provisioning is outside this local baseline.
control.updates: One canonical sorted patch of 1..32 unique row ordinals, exact consecutive epoch and unchanged key/shape/IDs; owner pins the new context first, then client verifies and atomically applies the entire authenticated patch. Gaps require full acquisition.
control.selection: All exact Hamming distances; rank (distance, original row ordinal), map positions to bound UInt64 IDs. IDs are labels. Old numeric-ID cache APIs remain unchanged.
control.native: New stateless isolated C++ XOR/popcount C ABI and bounded ctypes wrapper; no HE dependency, server-selected executable, native persistent data handle or GPU
control.ownership: Client and native wrapper are process-owned, non-copyable/non-pickleable, PID checked before locks, query/update/pin/acquisition linearized, closed contexts reject; no memory erasure claim
control.prefetch: Only late-download/currentness correctness in this gate; actual network/CPU overlap and contention are paid later in Q77
control.leakage: Public shape, packet lengths, opaque revisions/timing and ordered-ID digest are metadata; digest is not a hiding commitment. Same logical data binding across HE/cache requires honest owner and Q76.5 descriptor, not a claimed ciphertext-equivalence proof.

acceptance: Preserve preceding plan/implementation checkpoints, company files/libraries and current runtime source pins; commit registration before implementing; freeze executed sources/binaries/dependencies before gates

Sixteen saved small owner-canonical plaintext cases match independent literal-bit distances and saved full score vectors; six saved source-scale cases match independent plaintext XOR/popcount and saved top3. Do not claim a new comparison against complete private HE distance vectors not retained.
Three honest 32-row updates and six post-update searches match independent complete scores; changed ties use original ordinals and bound IDs
At least four equal-distance rows with reversed/nonmonotonic IDs distinguish tie membership as well as order, before/after updates

Reject wrong signatures/anchor/key/context, ciphertext faults, extra/truncated packets, noncanonical descriptors, malformed authenticated bodies, duplicate IDs, padding faults, update replay/gaps/cross-shape/late faults; failures cannot publish or partly mutate cache
Current pin invalidates old cache; late acquisition cannot publish it; query/close/update/thread/fork/copy/pickle ownership and direct C ABI length/null/alignment/overlap/sentinel faults are tested
All grammar/padding checks precede native output writes; direct callers remain responsible for valid allocated pointer spans
Gate new native code under normal and UBSan builds, and rerun only the existing cache controls needed for compatibility; do not sum overlapping sanitizer/test invocations as independent experiments

Record actual snapshot/update/descriptor bytes and canonical retained/scratch body accounting; distinguish Python/crypto/library overhead and process RSS from native stage peaks; no latency claim from this gate

Store public packets/anchors/fixtures/results/source and build receipts, never AES/signing secret keys; freshly regenerating support keys reproduces correctness but does not restore the archived ciphertext key context
Return the bounded gate to the progress ledger and checkpoint; next is Q76.5 certificate/resource/client-context handoff, not a new parameter sweep

claim_status.next_after_gate: Q76.5 certificate/resource/client-context handoff and conditional Q77
